intro: Niger is a vast Saharan and Sahel country, once crossed by great caravan routes, with dinosaur fossils and Tuareg traditions.

chapters.title: Green Sahara
text: Rock carvings like the Dabous giraffes show the Sahara was once green. At Gobero, graves of people who lived by a lake 9,000 years ago have been found.

chapters.title: Empires and Agadez
text: Parts of Niger belonged to the Songhai and Kanem-Bornu empires and the Hausa states. Agadez, with its tall mud minaret, was a key stop for caravans crossing the Sahara.

chapters.title: Colony and independence
text: France conquered the region in the 1890s and 1900s. Niger became independent in 1960. It has had several coups; in July 2023 the army overthrew elected president Mohamed Bazoum. French and US troops later left.

timeline.title: Peaceful handover
timeline.text: A first transfer between elected presidents.
